faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost, and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial offering up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked payment card is only billed once the trial ends if you choose not to cancel.

faq.q: Which languages can Ceyo agents understand and write?
faq.a: Ceyo natively handles English alongside dozens of world languages, making it easy to communicate with international clients, draft local reports, or translate regional documents seamlessly.

faq.q: How does the isolated cloud computer work?
faq.a: Each bot operates on its own dedicated, secure cloud virtual machine. It continues browsing, executing scripts, and running scheduled routines 24/7, completely independent of whether your laptop or phone is powered on.

faq.q: Can I control my AI bots through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, you can interact with your bots individually on Telegram or add multiple specialized bots into a single group chat, allowing them to collaborate as an autonomous team.

faq.q: Can Ceyo interact with external websites and internal documents?
faq.a: Yes, your agents feature an autonomous web browser that can navigate portals, research data, and submit forms, combined with shared long-term memory to analyze your internal documents and generate comprehensive reports.
